reasoning: Governor Mark Gordon is term-limited, which leaves an open Republican primary decided by plurality with no runoff. Megan Degenfelder, the statewide-elected Superintendent of Public Instruction, is one of the most prominent declared candidates. She has statewide name recognition, fundraising capacity and credible conservative credentials. Her rivals include Brent Bien, a Freedom Caucus-aligned candidate who took about 30% against Gordon in 2022, and Eric Barlow, the more moderate former House Speaker. Others, such as Chuck Gray, could still enter. A split field could favor her, but a high-profile entrant (such as Hageman, depending on the Senate situation) or a Trump endorsement of a rival could change the race. I'd treat her as a modest favorite.
